title: Breaking Down Bias: On The Limits of Generalizable Pruning Strategies

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual name substitution in advice-seeking prompts to simulate scenarios involving different racial groups. Disparities are measured by comparing quantifiable numeric outcomes (e.g., price estimates, hours, percentages) generated for Black-associated names versus White-associated names using Standardized Mean Difference (SMD) and Earth Mover's Distance (EMD).
